final_candidates.decision_summary: E484A has the highest EVEscape score (0.918) and excellent ProteinMPNN compatibility (0.976), indicating strong m102.4 escape potential with minimal structural disruption to the receptor-binding domain.

K490A provides moderate escape (0.643) with good structural compatibility (0.888); K490 is surface-exposed near the m102.4 epitope and alanine substitution may reduce antibody affinity without compromising fold integrity.
